title: Mexico-USMCA Review Risk Assessment
bluf: The USMCA joint review deadline of July 1, 2026 is the single most consequential macro event for Mexico-exposed portfolios this year. We assess a 60-75% probability of a 90-day extension, a 15-25% probability of selective tariffs on automotive and electronics, and a 5-15% probability of a full review breakdown.

headline_judgments.claim: USMCA extension is the most likely outcome (60-75%)
headline_judgments.subscriber_action: Buy KXTARIFFRATEPRC >9% strike as core hedge

headline_judgments.claim: Selective tariffs on automotive and electronics are possible (15-25%)
Full USMCA breakdown is a tail risk (5-15%)
headline_judgments.subscriber_action: Buy KXTARIFFRATEPRC >51% strike as tail hedge
